caption_final:
Six films and series to stream this weekend, five of them new on Friday, 13 November.

Netflix adds two films on Friday: Daayra, Meghna Gulzar's crime thriller, which reached cinemas on 18 September; and Heartland, a Netflix mystery thriller starring Jessica Chastain.

Also on Friday: the Hindi thriller series Student of the Year: After Dark on JioHotstar; the Hindi family comedy Parivarik ManuRanjan, which skipped cinemas, on Sony LIV; and the Malayalam action drama Bandra on ZEE5, three years after its November 2023 cinema run.

Jailer 2 has been on Prime Video since Thursday, 12 November, in Tamil, Telugu, Hindi, Malayalam and Kannada, in more than 240 countries and territories.

Which of these did you skip in cinemas to watch at home?
